# defineModule

Creates a top-level module that appears in the main navigation. Modules can contain resources and optionally have their own landing page component.

## Signature

```typescript
import { defineModule } from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

type ModuleOptions = Parameters<typeof defineModule>[0];
type AppModule = ReturnType<typeof defineModule>;
```

The option and return types can be derived from the public function; `DefineModuleProps` and `Module` are not package-root exports.

## Parameters

### `path`

- **Type:** `string`
- **Required:** Yes
- **Description:** URL path segment for the module

```typescript
defineModule({
  path: "products", // URL: /products
  meta: {},
  resources: [],
});
```

### `component`

- **Type:** `(props: ResourceComponentProps) => React.ReactNode`
- **Required:** No
- **Description:** Landing page component for the module. If omitted, the exact module path returns 404 while its child resource routes remain accessible, and its breadcrumb segment is plain text (not a link). Guards still run: use `redirectTo()` explicitly for a redirect; if all guards pass, the component-less path remains a 404.

**ResourceComponentProps:**

```typescript
type ResourceComponentProps = {
  title: string; // Resolved title
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  resources?: Array<ReturnType<typeof defineResource>>; // Child resources
};
```

Import `ResourceComponentProps` from AppShell when typing a page. AppShell passes `title` and `resources`; the optional `icon` field is not injected into page props.

### `resources`

- **Type:** `Array<ReturnType<typeof defineResource>>`
- **Required:** Yes
- **Description:** Array of resources within this module. Define using `defineResource()`.

### `meta`

- **Type:** `object`
- **Required:** Yes
- **Description:** Metadata configuration for the module. Pass `{}` to use the title derived from `path`.

**meta.title**

- **Type:** `string | LocalizedString`
- **Default:** Capitalized `path`
- **Description:** Display title in navigation and breadcrumbs

**meta.icon**

- **Type:** `React.ReactNode`
- **Description:** Icon displayed in sidebar navigation

**meta.breadcrumbTitle**

- **Type:** `string | ((segment: string) => LocalizedString)`
- **Description:** Custom breadcrumb segment title override. Pass `labels.t(key)` directly for localization: `breadcrumbTitle: labels.t("dashboard")`. Other callbacks receive the URL segment and may return a `LocalizedString`, resolved using the current locale. The existing `() => labels.t(key)` form remains supported; handwritten locale functions must be returned from an outer callback. When omitted, the breadcrumb uses the localized `meta.title`.

### `guards`

- **Type:** `Guard[]`
- **Required:** No
- **Description:** Access control guards executed in order. The first non-pass result stops execution: `hidden()` denies access and `redirectTo()` redirects.

See [Guards Overview](./guards/overview.md) for details.

### `errorBoundary`

- **Type:** `ErrorBoundaryComponent` (`React.ReactNode`)
- **Required:** No
- **Description:** Error boundary component for this module and its child resources. Use `useRouteError` hook to access error details.

## Return Type

```typescript
type AppModule = ReturnType<typeof defineModule>;
```

A module object that can be passed to the `modules` prop of `AppShell`.

## Examples

### Basic Module

```typescript
import { defineModule, Text } from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

const dashboardModule = defineModule({
  path: "dashboard",
  meta: { title: "Dashboard" },
  component: () => <Text.h1>Dashboard</Text.h1>,
  resources: [],
});
```

### Module with Icon and Title

```typescript
import { Home } from "lucide-react";

const dashboardModule = defineModule({
  path: "dashboard",
  meta: {
    title: "Dashboard",
    icon: <Home />,
  },
  component: DashboardPage,
  resources: [],
});
```

### Module with Resources

```typescript
const productsModule = defineModule({
  path: "products",
  meta: { title: "Products" },
  component: ProductsListPage,
  resources: [
    defineResource({
      path: ":id",
      component: ProductDetailPage,
    }),
    defineResource({
      path: "categories",
      component: CategoriesPage,
    }),
  ],
});
```

### Module without Component (Grouping Only)

```typescript
const dashboardModule = defineModule({
  path: "dashboard",
  meta: { title: "Dashboard" },
  // /dashboard returns 404; /dashboard/overview and /dashboard/analytics work
  resources: [
    defineResource({
      path: "overview",
      component: OverviewPage,
    }),
    defineResource({
      path: "analytics",
      component: AnalyticsPage,
    }),
  ],
});
```

### Module with Guards

```typescript
import { pass, hidden } from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

const adminModule = defineModule({
  path: "admin",
  meta: { title: "Admin" },
  component: AdminPage,
  resources: adminResources,
  guards: [
    ({ context }) => {
      return context.currentUser?.role === "admin" ? pass() : hidden();
    },
  ],
});
```

### Module with Error Boundary

```typescript
import { Text, useRouteError } from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

const ErrorBoundary = () => {
  const error = useRouteError() as Error;
  return (
    <div>
      <Text.h1>Module Error</Text.h1>
      <Text.p>{error.message}</Text.p>
    </div>
  );
};

const productsModule = defineModule({
  path: "products",
  meta: { title: "Products" },
  component: ProductsPage,
  resources: [],
  errorBoundary: <ErrorBoundary />,
});
```

### Module with Internationalization

```typescript
import { defineI18nLabels } from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

const labels = defineI18nLabels({
  en: { dashboard: "Dashboard" },
  ja: { dashboard: "ダッシュボード" },
});

const dashboardModule = defineModule({
  path: "dashboard",
  meta: {
    title: labels.t("dashboard"),
  },
  component: DashboardPage,
  resources: [],
});
```

## TypeScript

```typescript
import { defineModule } from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

type ModuleOptions = Parameters<typeof defineModule>[0];
type AppModule = ReturnType<typeof defineModule>;

const props: ModuleOptions = {
  path: "products",
  meta: { title: "Products" },
  component: ProductsPage,
  resources: [],
};

const productsModule: AppModule = defineModule(props);
```
